neighbours.label: The number or 'metric' immediately before a weight unit 'tonnes/tons' (setting up the unit), vs the same numbers before money, people or other units
fire: Last year the mill produced some 8,000 metric tons of paper for export.
The crane can lift loads of up to 50 tons onto the waiting ships.
The old battleship weighed 35 tonnes more than the newer design.
Farmers in the valley harvested about 12,000 metric tons of wheat.
Each locomotive weighs roughly 90 tonnes when fully loaded with fuel.
The quarry ships nearly 600 tons of granite every single week.
Officials said 1,200 metric tons of rice had been sent to the islands.
The new ferry can carry vehicles weighing up to 30 tonnes on its deck.
quiet: Last year the mill paid some 8,000 dollars in fines for late exports.
The crane company hired up to 50 workers for the busy shipping season.
The old battleship carried 35 more sailors than the newer design.
Farmers in the valley employed about 12,000 seasonal workers this year.
Each locomotive costs roughly 90 thousand euros to repaint and repair.
The quarry hires nearly 600 people from the nearby towns every year.
Officials said 1,200 families had been moved from the islands.
The new ferry can carry up to 30 cyclists on its upper deck.

predictions: Tokens before tonnes/tons 0.3-0.8; numbers before dollars/people/euros under 0.05.
notes: Card: ' billion' before 'tonnes of carbon' (-696), ' metric' before 'tons', digits before 'tonnes'. Probe: '4,500 metric tons' 0.774 on ' metric', '40 tons' 0.628, '$20 per metric ton' 0.545, '62 tonnes' 0.429, '300,000 tonnes' 0.282, '2 billion tonnes' 0.130; '2 billion dollars' 0.006, '4 million people' 0.016, '45 euros' 0.001. The card's + pole suppresses ' ton', so this pole predicts the unit.
